root = Card([header, tbl, keep])
header = CardHeader("Storage tiers: contents & deletion", "docs/STORAGE.md §4–§5, §13–§14")
tbl = Table([tier, contents, deletion])
tier = Col("Tier", ["install\nuserData/", "account\naccounts/<acc_id>/", "workspace\naccounts/<acc>/workspaces/<wsp>/"])
contents = Col("What lives there", ["install-id only — telemetry/crash reporting, never in a session token (§8). Accounts share nothing but this parent directory.", "account.db — device_id, workspace index / switcher membership cache, unread/mention/outbox hints, IPC epoch; auth/refresh-<wsp>.bin vault files (one per workspace); avatar blobs (account tier so the rail renders off-workspace avatars, §14)", "relayed.db — chats, messages, stream cursors (stream_state, staged_events), last_read, unread counters, outbox, drafts (§5, §7); message-attachment blobs (§14)"])
deletion = Col("When deleted", ["Never by the app. No deletion path exists — it spans all accounts and dies only with the install itself.", "On sign out of the account: /auth/signout per stored refresh token, then rm -rf the whole directory — DB, blobs, vault together, so it can't be half-done (§13, goal 4).", "On removal from the workspace: membership gone from memberships → state='removed', then replica, blobs, and vault slot are deleted (§13). Attachments also follow per-workspace message eviction (§13.6/§14)."])
keep = Callout("neutral", "Switching and auth failure delete nothing", "Switching away keeps the refresh token and the server session live (§9, invariant 44). Token expiry / refresh failure only sets state='stale' — local reads continue, nothing is wiped (§13). The only destructive operations are account sign-out and workspace removal.")
calls.text:
Storage tiers: contents & deletion: docs/STORAGE.md §4–§5, §13–§14
Tier: install
userData/, What lives there: install-id only — telemetry/crash reporting, never in a session token (§8). Accounts share nothing but this parent directory., When deleted: Never by the app. No deletion path exists — it spans all accounts and dies only with the install itself.; Tier: account
accounts/<acc_id>/, What lives there: account.db — device_id, workspace index / switcher membership cache, unread/mention/outbox hints, IPC epoch; auth/refresh-<wsp>.bin vault files (one per workspace); avatar blobs (account tier so the rail renders off-workspace avatars, §14), When deleted: On sign out of the account: /auth/signout per stored refresh token, then rm -rf the whole directory — DB, blobs, vault together, so it can't be half-done (§13, goal 4).; Tier: workspace
accounts/<acc>/workspaces/<wsp>/, What lives there: relayed.db — chats, messages, stream cursors (stream_state, staged_events), last_read, unread counters, outbox, drafts (§5, §7); message-attachment blobs (§14), When deleted: On removal from the workspace: membership gone from memberships → state='removed', then replica, blobs, and vault slot are deleted (§13). Attachments also follow per-workspace message eviction (§13.6/§14).
Switching and auth failure delete nothing: Switching away keeps the refresh token and the server session live (§9, invariant 44). Token expiry / refresh failure only sets state='stale' — local reads continue, nothing is wiped (§13). The only destructive operations are account sign-out and workspace removal.

reply:
The document defines three tiers (§4–§5), and deletion is specified in §13 with blob retention in §14. Here is the comparison:

One caveat the table doesn't cover: within the workspace tier there's a retention policy short of full deletion — past the ~500-rev sync threshold, old history is replaced by gap markers with a recent tail kept per chat and lazy backfill on open (§7), and §13.6 caps blob bytes per workspace. Whether an install-wide blob cap should sit on top of the per-workspace one is still an open question (§20.4). Everything else destructive funnels through just two operations: sign out (account-tier wipe) and workspace removal (single-workspace wipe).
